## History

James A. lived in Scottsford, [New Brunswick](../codex/places.md#new-brunswick), and kept house with his sister until she died, after which he married [Emily](../character/emily.md) Scott as he had promised his sister he would do. Following a two-week wedding trip to St. John, he separated from [Emily](../character/emily.md) over a dispute regarding his parrot, [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), and subsequently moved to Prince [Edward Island](../codex/places.md#edward-island).

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P9](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0009), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P16](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0016), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P28](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0028), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P55](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0055), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P58](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0058), +1 more_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--james-a.md)

[Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and James A are friendly neighbors who frequently talk and share food with one another. Their close neighborhood bond is reflected in James A turning to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) during a personal crisis, asking her to come to his home so he can explain the unexpected arrival and background of his estranged wife, [Emily](../character/emily.md).

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P9](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0009), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P16](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0016), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P28](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0028), +2 more_
